- Do you want us to send a pre-event calendar invite (ICS) immediately on RSVP or only after confirmation?

- 10m: Intro + use cases (Redwood + DataWave quick wins)

- 15m: Q&A + follow-ups

Hi Marissa — thanks, excited about this. A few answers and a small ask: 

1) Unique RSVP links per attendee group would be ideal (we track attendance by team).
2) Please send a calendar invite immediately on RSVP — that reduces no-shows for our platform engineers.

One small ask on content: can you include a 5–7 slide appendix showing how Redwood handles multi-tenant KV cache separation? Our infra lead wants a short slide to share internally before the session. If you can share slides 24 hours before, we’ll promote the webinar internally.

Thanks —
